title: Final Answer for +q
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the minimum positive charge Q required when the external charge is +q.

title: Final Answer for -q
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the minimum positive charge Q required when the external charge is -q.

title: Induced Charge Density
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the expression for the induced surface charge density on the sphere due to the external charge.

title: Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct calculation of the electric field at the surface of the sphere due to the external charge.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors in the calculations of induced charge density and electric field.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all quantities are expressed in consistent units throughout the solution.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or special scenarios to reinforce understanding of the problem.
